{
  "subtype": "predictive_feature_engineering",
  "focus_variable": "state_declined",
  "per_column": [
    {"name": "missing_source_id", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Absence of a source id is a plausible data-quality signal available at or before decision time and lies outside the outcome."},
    {"name": "missing_processed_date", "role": "leakage", "is_predictor": false, "rationale": "Whether a processed date exists is tightly coupled to whether/how the expense reached a terminal state; it is largely determined by the outcome-processing step rather than being an independent pre-decision predictor."},
    {"name": "is_pending", "role": "restatement", "is_predictor": false, "rationale": "Derived from the same 'state' field as the focus; pending vs declined are mutually exclusive states, so this restates/partitions the outcome variable rather than predicting it."},
    {"name": "is_submitted", "role": "restatement", "is_predictor": false, "rationale": "Also a decode of the 'state' field. Being in another state category is a component of the same outcome variable, not an external predictor."},
    {"name": "is_it_department", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Department is a legitimate ex-ante attribute plausibly correlated with decline rates and independent of the outcome."},
    {"name": "is_travel_category", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Expense category is known before adjudication and can carry signal about decline likelihood."},
    {"name": "amount_is_low", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Thresholded amount is a pre-decision feature plausibly related to decline (small amounts auto-approved)."},
    {"name": "amount_is_high", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "High-amount flag is an ex-ante predictor plausibly linked to scrutiny and decline."},
    {"name": "processing_delay_days", "role": "leakage", "is_predictor": false, "rationale": "Computed from processed_date, which is post-adjudication; the 999 sentinel coincides with missing processed date and thus encodes the outcome. Not knowable before the decision."},
    {"name": "risk_score", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "An engineered composite risk indicator; if built from pre-decision attributes it is a legitimate predictor, though its provenance is opaque and could hide leakage. Judged conservatively as a predictor."}
  ],
  "n_predictors": 6,
  "predictive_utility": 0.45,
  "rationale": "The set is a mix. Genuine ex-ante predictors (department, category, amount thresholds, missing_source_id, and a composite risk_score) provide real, if modest, predictive leverage on decline. However several columns undermine the claim: is_pending and is_submitted merely decode the same 'state' field the target comes from (restatement/partition of the outcome), and missing_processed_date / processing_delay_days derive from processed_date, a post-decision timestamp whose sentinel value coincides with unprocessed items — classic leakage. Because a meaningful fraction of the added columns restate or leak the focus, overall independent predictive utility beyond the original columns is moderate."
}
